headline: Confirmed Anthony Geraci as police chief, 10-2; approved up to $558,500 in water fund spending; referred recycling ordinance to committee.
summary: Tobacco applications for Henry Street Deli Mart and Wolfs Convenience Store passed, 10-2 each. Joanna Grossman was appointed to the Church Street Marketplace Commission 7-5, and Bruce Wilson to the Winooski Valley Park District board 8-4. Robert O'Brien's nomination to the park district board failed 4-8, and the park district's annual report and funding request was postponed to November 23, 2026.
decisions: Adopted the consent agenda, including use of up to $558,500 from the Water Fund 460 fund balance, unanimously.
Confirmed Anthony Geraci as Chief of Police, 10-2.
Approved the 2026-2027 Indoor Entertainment Permit for Vermont Comedy Arts, 118 Main Street, unanimously.
Approved the 2026-2027 Tobacco Substitute Endorsement for Henry Street Deli Mart, 11 Henry Street, 10-2.
Approved the 2026-2027 Tobacco License and Tobacco Substitute Endorsement for Wolfs Convenience Store LLC, 457 St. Paul Street, 10-2.
Appointed Joanna Grossman to the Church Street Marketplace Commission, term expiring 6/30/29, 7-5.
Nomination of Robert O'Brien to the Winooski Valley Park District board failed, 4-8.
Appointed Bruce Wilson to the Winooski Valley Park District board, term expiring 6/30/27, 8-4.
Referred the recycling collection requirements ordinance, BCO Chapter 14, to the Ordinance Committee, unanimously.
Postponed the Winooski Valley Park District FY26 annual report and FY28 funding request to the November 23, 2026 Deliberative Agenda, unanimously.
